description: Switch the active Optibot organization. Rescopes your token so subsequent tool calls act as that organization. Accept either organizationId or name — if multiple orgs share a name, provide organizationId instead. Token is replaced in ~/.optibot/config.json.

name.description: Organization name (or displayName) to switch to. Used only when organizationId is not provided. Must match exactly one organization.

organizationId.description: Organization id to switch to. Provide either organizationId or name.

name: switch_organization
